profile_text.body:
Lumen Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, trading under the ticker LUMN. On its website the company describes itself as providing secure networking, edge cloud and AI-ready infrastructure over a global fiber network, and calls itself the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy. It says its fiber footprint is intended to reduce latency for real-time performance.

The site presents customer examples rather than named AI products. It describes work with the New York Yankees, citing diverse 100G paths and automatic failover between Yankee Stadium and digital operations facilities in Tampa, and with American Family Care, an urgent care provider scaling across 26 states. It also describes building a private, low-latency network for heavy AI workloads for Prometheus Hyperscale, which anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while keeping performance steady. For retail, the company says its network provides security for transactions and protection from DDoS attacks.

The record shows no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. Louisiana is listed as the jurisdiction with the highest litigation exposure, with a count of 57.
